zh: 修复关闭工作区开关后归档删除按钮仍在渲染、占位文案不随特性退出还原、折叠动画期间的第二次点击被丢弃，以及等待徽章退场定时器不随特性停止的问题。
en: Fix the archived-row delete action staying mounted after the workspace switch is turned off, placeholder text not being restored when the feature stands down, a second fold click dropped during the closing animation, and the wait badge's exit timer outliving its feature.
